summary: The main article describes a visible-light photoredox catalytic method for the N-arylation of lactams using pyridinium-based nitrogen radical precursors. It includes optimization tables, reaction scopes covering various heteroarenes and biomolecules, and a section on continuous flow and aqueous media applications.
